name: theme-stadium
title: Stadium theme
description: A floodlit broadcast look for live sport: flat colour on deep navy, gold for interactive controls and teal for the selected state. Install it, then set data-gs-theme="stadium" on the root.
docs: Import gamestage-theme-stadium.css after gamestage-tokens.css, and set data-gs-theme="stadium" on <html> or on any subtree. Stadium changes colour and nothing else, and keeps the base DM Sans and Unbounded pairing, which is why it depends on @gamestage/fonts rather than on a font item of its own. Compare it with @gamestage/theme-paper, which changes typeface, press gesture, edge treatment and radius as well.
